ad_or_analytics.instructions: Is `item.host` (see `item.example_paths`) an advertising, remarketing or web-analytics service that measures visitors?

session_recording.instructions: Is `item.host` a session-recording or heatmap service that records how visitors move, click or type?

booking.instructions: Is `item.host` an online appointment booking or scheduling service?

call_tracking.instructions: Is `item.host` a call-tracking service that swaps or tracks phone numbers?

form_or_crm.instructions: Is `item.host` a form-handling, chat, CRM or lead-capture service that receives what visitors type?

needed_service.instructions: Is `item.host` a plain infrastructure service (fonts, CDN, maps, video, captcha, bot protection, accessibility, site builder assets) rather than tracking?
